title: Bhai Taru Singh hears of the Nawab's death and prepares for departure

blocks.text: The page first closes the Nawab sequence by declaring that Bhai Taru Singh preserved the Khalsa Panth's honour when the ruler who oppressed the Sikhs fell exactly as foretold. Bhai Taru Singh and Bhai Subeg Singh rendered great service by turning state violence into a public vindication of the Panth.

News of the Nawab's death then reached Bhai Taru Singh himself, and he responded with serenity rather than surprise. He told his companions to ask for his funeral pyre to be prepared, as though the time of his own departure had already been plainly announced.

Sacred observances were then arranged around him with joy and reverence. The page opens the martyr’s final scene not in panic, but in calm readiness for a death already accepted as part of divine order.
